title: Action-grounded tissue affordance enables anticipatory auto-framing that lowers surgeon cognitive workload during laparoscopic surgery
abstract: arXiv:2608.02471v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In laparoscopy, surgeon gaze tracks where the instruments will act; easing this demand through visual attention modeling requires dense labels of those interaction loci. These encode tacit knowledge: experts converge on consensus loci yet struggle to state the rules. Here we show that such labels can be recovered from completed actions in surgical videos, in which recorded instrument trajectories are converted into dense, continuous supervision. DiffeoAfford grounds tissue affordance by attaching instrument tips to the tissue and transporting them through deformation using diffeomorphism-constrained tracking, matching context-informed annotators' accuracy. Trained on these labels and never on gaze, a real-time model aligns with surgeon gaze more closely in space and time than does camera-assistant gaze. translated_title: 基于动作的組織可供性实现预期自动取景，降低腹腔镜手术中外科医生的认知负荷
translated_abstract: 在腹腔镜手术中，外科医生的视线追踪器械将要操作的位置；通过视觉注意力建模来减轻这一需求，需要对这些交互位点的密集标签。这些标签编码了隐性知识：专家会收敛于共识位点，但难以陈述其规则。我们在此表明，这类标签可以从手术视频中已完成动作中恢复，其中记录的器械轨迹被转换为密集、连续的监督信号。DiffeoAfford通过将器械尖端附着于组织，并利用微分同胚约束的跟踪通过变形传输它们，从而建立组织可供性，其精度与情境匹配的标注者相当。在仅基于这些标签且从未使用视线数据训练的情况下，一个实时模型在空间和时间上比摄像头助手视线更紧密地对齐外科医生的视线。该框架还可跨手术迁移：在子宫切除术视频上，一个单独训练的预测器达到了95.16%的方向准确率。
tldr: 本文提出DiffeoAfford方法，从手术视频中已完成动作恢复密集标签，训练实时模型实现预期自动取景，显著降低外科医生认知负荷并跨手术泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DiffeoAfford, which recovers dense labels from completed actions in surgical videos to train a real-time model for anticipatory auto-framing, reducing surgeon cognitive load and generalizing across procedures.
